writablePathsGate's entry-scope matchesAny sources from the same shared helper instead of its own spread (builtinGates.ts:438-441).

summary: Prompt.ts effectiveFenceLines and builtinGates.ts writablePathsGate independently re-derive the same entryPaths∪channelPaths union — extract one shared computation.

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

tests.asserts: shared union helper dedups entryPaths ∪ channelPaths, including empty-array cases
effective-fence render agrees with writablePathsGate's actual accepted scope for a shared phase/entry fixture — not just the comment's claim
